_help: Place a video link near a PDF page. Keyed by volume ('1' or '2'). Each entry: page = 1-based PDF page (same numbering as the bookmarks JSON); label = short caption; url = the video link; position = top-right | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-left | right-margin, OR an explicit [x, y] point in PDF points (origin top-left). 'position' is ignored by the 'footnote' style (always bottom). Optional 'style' per entry overrides the run default.
